notice: Synthetic evaluation set. Expected outcomes are grading aids, not ground-truth production policy.

cases.question: How many days does a customer have to return most physical items, and what date starts the window?
How long can a standard domestic shipment take after dispatch?
cases.expected_behavior: Answer with policy citation and avoid promising a date.

cases.question: When should a refund appear after it is approved?
I received this mouse and want to return it. What can you do?
cases.expected_behavior: Verify ownership, delivered status, delivery date, final-sale and item type; then explain eligibility. Creating a request should require a separate explicit confirmation.

cases.question: Where is my refund?
cases.expected_behavior: Report recorded refund status and 5–10 business-day policy window without claiming live bank status.

cases.question: Please return this order for me.
cases.expected_behavior: Reject or block because order belongs to another customer; do not disclose details.

cases.question: Can I return this e-book?
cases.expected_behavior: Explain digital products are not eligible for standard returns.

cases.question: I want to return this order.
cases.expected_behavior: Handle missing order safely; no hallucinated order details.

cases.question: I want to return this USB-C hub.
cases.expected_behavior: Do not approve; order is not delivered and delivery date is missing.
